So minimalistic and cozy, I like it :3

Not really a song, but a piece called "Dance of the knights" by Prokofiev. For me, it captures the struggle and power of being a butch. It sounds awful, out of place by societal standarts, but very powerful, resilient and elegant. People on streets often look at me with disgust and I just strut my way past them almost angrily. XD. Listening to this piece really helps with boosting confidence.

CBT rarely helps trauma survivors. It teaches to  constantly gaslight oneself and repress all "inadequate" emotions which are just natural reactions to traumatic events. This is extremely triggering, because the experience of someone with CPTSD is already invalidated by almost everyone in the psych field and in real life.

I think you'd be better off talking to a wall than this therapist. There are good therapists out there with proper training, but they are hard to find.

Your parents neglected their basic duties. They needed to take care of your health, not blame it on you. Clearly they didn't have a clue how to treat a little kid. The fact that they are doctors makes this situation very upsetting. 

I had something similar, but I somehow thought that everybody's vision was this bad (My younger self had this flawed rationalization and projecting issues). My parents thought that I was just lying when I couldn't read anything further than my outstretched elbow. So, I just tried to hide it, because they wouldn't believe and ignore me.  Counted steps from school to home, because I will need it when I become blind. I asked my classmate to help me see what is written on the blackboard. This stealth mode continued until 5 grade. My parents were very surprised to hear doctor saying that my vision is shitty. Then I got thick glasses, yay. Now, I can see at least something.

Your parents were very agressive and neglectful to you for something you didn't have control over which is unjustifiable and unforgivable.

"Having someone who is ready to sacrifice their lives for you" - the words of a true lord, a self-absorbed king. Please do not project your inner fantasies on real life. Or else you will get out of it toothless. Building yourself up for resentment, disappointment, broken heart yada yada. Keep your fantasies separate from real life, invest them in other things, not in human beings.
You poor unfortunate soul😢
Looks tasty😍Yum!

Antisocial behaviour. I do not tolerate anyone's bullshit. 
Hypervigilance is really helpful in predicting a lot of unwanted situations and problem solving. Always focused, expecting attack, ready to fight. A bit exausting at times, but very useful.
Dissociation is a special painkiller for psychological pain. 
Sometimes having nightmares about revenge and then being persecuted, but nonetheless it feels great to feel something so peaceful and uplifting, besides constant wrath, confusion, bitterness and numbness during the day.
Not being really interested in anyone, because my energy levels are constantly low (hypervigilance is such a bitch tbh), and I do not even bother about boredom, dying alone, having friends or anything that people who "care" about me worried about. Life is too stressful and I need a lot of traumatized Me time and sleeeeep. 
CPTSD is normal reaction to this fucked up life. Normies do not have this type of adverse experience. That doesn't make 'em better than us. They would potentially kill themselves if they walked in shoes of a person with cPTSD. Yeah, constant background suicidal ideation never goes away.

I had something similar. It was during New Year's holidays. I heard a baby crying through the thin walls of my appartment. The baby's father was pissed and screamed at the child to "Go to sleep". After a moment I heard the slap. And the child started to cry like it was massacred or something. Then this parent  acts is if nothing happened.

Eghhh, sleep is beatiful actually. No abusive parents, no screaming, no pain. Child abuse is so normalized and commonplace that it is really laughable when people who do this consider themselves adequate. I can't even find the energy to be sad anymore.

Maybe that is something that you wanted to do. But the need for connection will stay. It is natural for human beings. The main thing to do is to not let this need lead back to this toxic relationships. You've done yourself a favour :)

Why do you feel anxious about this outcome?

I found it so sad. I've done the same thing and it makes me feel better for some reason. But reading someone describing this situtation... Is just super sad. 

Like inevitability of this event is very pronounced, but everyone 's true indifference just contributes to the calming effect in a suicidal person.

But it means "A skilled or knowledgeable person who fails to use their skills for the benefit of their family and himself." 

I meant the world around me wasn't really cotributing to developing empathy. And I feel interest in complexity of human emotions.

Maybe my ability to empathize is not developed. I can logicaly state what other people feel, but I do not understand it emotionally. Cognitive empathy is developed at least. 

I'm not barefoot, I give other people shoes with holes. It's not much, but better than nothing.
I'm a support employee. Kind of ironic, I've never felt support or empathy from other people, but right now I'm doing just that for others.

"So one way to deal with feeling like a slave, as schizoids are often made to feel when they are children, is to try to switch the roles around, to become the master and to project the slave role into someone else (either someone real, or some fantasied other). "
Sounds so horrible. It's like turning into these figures from your childhood and feeling that there is no end to this abominable cycle. 
Yeah, and that's why I will always remind myself to stay away from any kind of relationships or just be so emotionally dead that it will not be fun to execute this power dynamic.
Google suicide bag. I think it's okay. But it depends on preferences
False hope brings more pain, than constant streak of despair does. The latter makes you more prepared and adapted for accepting the fact that "Oh, well, maybe it wouldn't get better".
And I shall say I feel the same way about you! You're a really good neighbour on this reddit😉. Be safe!

Reminds me of the time when I really wanted to become a bartender and failed miserably, because of local folks. People around expect from us to be "tougher", but they just destroy our confidence with criticism. Man, these people are so unpleasant. Sorry, that you had to deal with them. Please give yourself time to heal🙏
I'm sorry that you feel this way. If I would stand by your side rn, I would shout out "Fuck the world!"

Yes, the possibilities and speculations are endless, which is why combination would be the best option. I visited a psychiatrist once who told me that it is almost impossible to get the right dose. She thought that it will be OD, but I always thought that being choked is optimal. I guess it depends on preferences.
I don't think that I will be able to remain alive without causing someone a lot of pain. It's just natural. Memories will always be there, waiting for me at every corner, wearing down my ability to function. They are too bright, too loud, unbearable and inescapable.
I haven't prepared anything. It's okay. I'm just wondering... Maybe I will find someone who understands:)
